item.title: The worthlessness of Vitamin D is mildly exaggerated
item.description:
📝 Am I certain that vitamin D is beneficial for people with low-ish levels. 1 The classical “endocrine” story of vitamin D is that your body uses it to tell your guts to take in more calcium from food. It also tells your kidneys to convert some of the storage vitamin D from your blood into active vitamin D.
🔗 Read more: https://dynomight.net/vitamin-d/

item.title: AI Hiring Tools Yield Racial Bias and Systemic Rejection; 26% Black & 15% Asian
item.description:
📝 Entry-level hiring has slowed. The vendor we study screens applicants for many different positions across many employers. We find that people who submit multiple applications to positions screened by the same algorithmic hiring vendor are more likely to be rejected from every position to which they apply than would be true if the companies made decisions statistically independently from one another.
🔗 Read more: https://hai.stanford.edu/news/ai-hiring-tools-can-yield-racial-bias-and-systemic-rejection
